title: Lead Like A CEO Podcast| Proven Leadership Strategies for Mission-Driven CEOs to Elevate Performance
author: Shevvy Mac| Team Development, Business Operations + Program Management Consultant
description: The Lead Like A CEO Podcast is the go-to podcast for established mission driven businesse owners and organizational leaders ready for proven leadership strategies to elevate their leadership, teams performance, and drive growth while regaining their time. I'm your host, Shevvy, a retired Air Force veteran turned People Development and Business Operations Consultant with 22-plus years of experience. I'm a mom to three and a lover of dancing. Lead Like A CEO and get your time back. Follow on LinkedIn @Shevvy Mac or IG @macleadeshipacademy website: www.macleadershipacademy.com email us at info@m
